diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a moderate downward trend (a net fall of ~82% of its level). There is little seasonal structure. A few outliers stand out (10 points, ~2% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau 0.025), which favours a robust combination.
